rows.summary: The board page now shows the same not-saved alert as the grid (role=alert, NOT_SAVED_MESSAGES.boards) and the RecoveryNotice for a saved list that could not be read in full, through one BoardStorageNotice both pages use.

The normaliser part was already fixed (a9eacee; boardMigrate turns a v1 list with missing/null cards into an empty column). But at base both board pages still read v1 boards (b.lists, store.moveCard…) over the v2 store, so /boards and /boards/:id crashed for every saved board, the demo and the row's repro included. Both pages now read a v2 project through src/utils/boardView.js and call the v2 actions; the repro opens on both pages with an empty column.

Card ids are unique across the whole board since 08aaa66 (B-15), and v2 completeBoard keeps one `seen` set for every issue, column, label, sprint and checklist item; moveIssue takes the card out by index. A new drag test pins that dragging either of two cards saved with one id loses neither.

Store, normaliser, ops, migration and transfer tests already existed (tests/unit/board-*.unit.mjs, normalize-board.unit.mjs). Now added: drag-and-drop (boardView.dropTarget over the real moveIssue/moveColumn, every index checked against arrayMove) and both pages (SSR markup, plus a fake-dom mount driving add card, labels, delete list and the card title).

Boards now have tests (see R2-155), and the file normalizeBoard.js cites exists. The job side: Pipeline (every state), the Tasks tab (add, tick, rename, delete, newest completed first) and the kanban drop (another column changes the status; its own column or outside does nothing) are tested on the real components.

issues: Card sheet title: each keystroke went through updateIssue's cleanTitle and came back trimmed, so a space before the next word was removed and a cleared field refilled itself (a regression from the v2 wiring).
A picked palette colour whose name matched a label of another colour got that label (addLabel returns the existing label with that name).
fixedByReviewer: 60b40ff: the title field shows what was typed while it has focus; a new label takes the next free name ('Blue 2'); tests added for both, and for deleting the only list or an empty list

notes: At base the Board pages (src/pages/Board.jsx, Boards.jsx) were never ported to board store v2 and crashed on every visit. This branch ports them minimally: they keep the v1 look (BoardColumn/BoardCard/CardDetailSheet) and read v2 through src/utils/boardView.js. BoardCard.jsx was not touched (R2-039 belongs to the jobs cluster). 097052a (a follow-up asked for by the owner: functionality only, no a11y work) makes the board show what the v2 data says: a scrum project shows only its active sprint, and new cards join it; with no sprint started it shows every card and says so, since nothing in the app starts a sprint until the backlog page lands. Done cards resolved longer ago than hideDoneAfterDays are hidden, and the page says how many. A column with a WIP limit reads n/limit, red when over. Still open until the planned v2 pages (BOARDS-UI-A/B) replace this one: no UI sets a WIP limit, starts a sprint or changes hideDoneAfterDays; epics show as plain cards; a new list goes before Done (the v2 addColumn rule). Deleting a list that has cards now moves them to the list beside it and does not delete them.
